corrections.title: Exact Cere/Malicos/Cal A-tier 3v3 Hondo counter
corrections.rationale: Issue #163 approves the exact lineups and non-provisional A tier. In the implementation conversation, after the mandatory-score blocker was explained, the owner explicitly instructed “Use 56”, approving 56 as the planning estimate. The linked issue body records the original battle/lineup approval; the supplemental score decision is from that conversation, not a claim that the issue body originally approved an estimate. A separate CERE_CAL definition is necessary for exact Cal ownership and shared-unit spending without changing the global CERE core. Reuse the existing Pirate King Hondo identity; add its missing exact 3v3 composition.

evidence.supports: Exact three-person defending/attacking lineups, one observed full-clear 56-banner win, non-provisional A tier.

provenance.conditions: Exact 3v3 lineups only; datacron, omicron, relic and mod conditions unknown.
provenance.confidence: Low for repeatability: One directly reported owner win; A tier and 56 planning estimate are owner judgements, not independently measured reliability or average banners.
provenance.limitations: No externally verified exact-match sample or win rate. Supplemental planning-score approval “Use 56” was supplied in the implementation conversation.
